description: This header file declares utility functions for handling USP (Universal Service Proxy) message processing, including creation, validation, and processing of request and response messages related to USP services.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_Create_GetReq
methods.description: Creates a USP Get Request message with specified message ID, key-value vector, and depth.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_Create_SetReq
methods.description: Creates a USP Set Request message with specified message ID and key-value vector.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_Create_AddReq
methods.description: Creates a USP Add Request message with specified message ID, path, group addition parameters, and number of parameters.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_Create_DeleteReq
methods.description: Creates a USP Delete Request message with specified message ID, paths, and partial allow flag.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_Create_GetSupportedDMReq
methods.description: Creates a request message for supported data models.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_Create_GetInstancesReq
methods.description: Creates a request message for specific instances.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_Create_OperateReq
methods.description: Creates an operation request message with specified message ID, path, command key, and input arguments.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_ValidateUspResponse
methods.description: Validates a USP response message against expected response type and reports parameter errors.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_ProcessUspService_GetResponse
methods.description: Processes a USP Get response message and fills a key-value vector.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_ProcessUspService_SetResponse
methods.description: Processes a USP Set response message.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_ProcessUspService_AddResponse
methods.description: Processes a USP Add response message and updates key vectors and instance info.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_ProcessUspService_DeleteResponse
methods.description: Processes a USP Delete response message and associated path.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_ProcessUspService_OperateResponse
methods.description: Processes a USP Operate response message and outputs result.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_ProcessUspService_GetInstancesResponse
methods.description: Processes a response for GetInstances request, filling instance list.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_ProcessUspService_GetSupportedDMResponse
methods.description: Processes a supported data model response message.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_Extend_AddReq
methods.description: Extends a message by adding an Add request with path and group parameters.
